tools.name: cart_update_item
tools.description: Update quantity, notes, or selected options on an existing cart line item. Quantity <= 0 removes the item.

tools.name: store_list
tools.description: List stores available to the current user. Optional longitude and latitude improve distance sorting.

tools.name: storefront_verify_result
tools.description: Store key: call after running the verify command, with the runId of that latest run. Pass or fail per check, and whether the server saw the run's sandbox order paid; when green, the go-live list. The CLI's PASS/WAIT/FAIL lines are authoritative: checks that only WAITed (sandbox guest sign-in) are mi

tools.name: storefront_connect
tools.description: Store key: call when the site is served from a process that keeps running (background, fixed port) and menu items show at that origin. Use http://localhost:<port>, not 127.0.0.1: the sandbox key allows only localhost. Returns whether the origin is allowed, a runId and the exact verify command; run i

tools.name: menu_list
tools.description: List categories and products, with each product's allergens, for a store after delivery type has been selected. Delivery type affects product availability and prices. Results come in pages of whole categories; when nextPage is set, call again with that page for more.

tools.name: cart_add_item
tools.description: Add a configured product to the cart. Use product_configure first for required variant option ids.

tools.name: checkout_verify
tools.description: Verify an external payment after the user has completed the returned payment URL. Provider is vipps or dintero.

tools.name: kit_docs_get
tools.description: Public: with topic, that topic as Markdown; read assemble-a-shop, world-class-ordering-ux, verify-contract and the-return-page before building, the others when the steps name them. With block: where to read that reference block's source; read it, never install it. Without arguments: the topic and bl

tools.name: server_info
tools.description: Public: basic information about the Okam MCP server.

tools.name: kit_learn
tools.description: Public: call first whenever you build or change a restaurant's own ordering website on Okam. Returns the must-nots (the server owns every price, payment is the guest's own act), the build steps, the sandbox key, the topics and, with framework, the scaffold plan. The kit gives logic and outcomes, nev

tools.name: payment_methods_list
tools.description: List payment methods available for the current cart/user. Saved Stripe cards have ids; Dintero and Vipps are returned as payment types.

tools.name: cart_validate
tools.description: Validate the current cart before checkout.

tools.name: store_get
tools.description: Get store details, including supported delivery types. Choose a delivery type before listing menu prices.

tools.name: cart_get
tools.description: Get the current cart for a store.

tools.name: cart_set_delivery
tools.description: Set cart delivery type and delivery details. This must be called before listing product prices or adding products to cart.

tools.name: delivery_availability_check
tools.description: Check whether Wolt delivery can deliver to an address and return the delivery price if available.

tools.name: product_configure
tools.description: Get all variants, option ids and allergens for configuring a product before adding it to cart.

tools.name: checkout_start
tools.description: Start checkout with Dintero or DinteroVipps. Returns a Dintero payment URL and reference; the guest approves the payment on Dintero's page. A zero-amount cart completes immediately. An unchanged cart gets the same payment link back.
